description: Greater Manchester speed-limit and speed-camera acceptance checkpoints. Every expectation is an explicit OpenStreetMap tag read from the OSM API (api.openstreetmap.org/api/0.6/map, 10 Oct 2026); nothing is a guess and no Mapillary data is involved. Points are mapped road vertices; headings follow the way direction. Expected mph is the tagged maxspeed (70 mph on a motorway mainline is also the UK national limit; none of these ways shows a lower or variable signed limit).
